title: Packages page: offer Enable / Disable on a suite's type:module rows once the server allows disabling them
body:
coordinator#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgV5XwfXsVDMWfbUvBv

Filing gate: ③ ordered by the maintainer. Ruling thread, quoted verbatim (not translated):
> 2026-10-30 13:05Z: 同意 (plan A of the suite-module analysis: customer admins switch modules; per environment; disabled = hidden + data-plane refusal + data kept — see #28117)
> 2026-10-30 13:07Z, asked whether the Console needs a NEW "suite modules" page: 最小做法：

"最小做法" = no new page, no new route, no new nav item. The existing Packages page gets the switch.

Business reason: once #28117 lets an admin disable a suite's module, the customer's admin needs a place to do it without calling the API. The Packages page already has the Disable / Enable button and a confirm dialog; today it shows Disable only on `writable` rows, so a module row (read-only for authoring) would never offer it.
Reader who acts: the ui lane, one small PR in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx` (+ its tests).
Dedupe (open AND closed): semantic search "Packages page disable button module package read-only": 0 relevant hits (#7560 is the server gate). 0 open duplicates.

Blocked-by: #28117

Back-link: #28117 · ⛔ Not a claim.

## Today (origin/main `b6c2ed9c`)

- `PackagesPage.tsx` L1054: the Disable / Enable button renders when `writable || !enabled`; Disable opens the confirm dialog (`pkg-detail-disable-dialog`, L1272), then `PATCH /api/v1/packages/:id/disable|enable` (L876).
- The confirm copy `engine.packages.detail.disableDescription` already says the consequence: en "The package is taken out of service for every user until it is enabled again. No records are deleted, and you can enable it again at any time." / zh 「在重新启用之前，此软件包将对所有用户停止服务。不会删除任何记录，您可以随时重新启用。」 (`ui/packages/i18n/src/namespaces/studio/{en,zh}.ts`).
- Setup's "Installed Apps" entry (`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-ui.ts` L47-80) opens this same `developer:packages` component filtered `?source=marketplace`.
- Whether a suite's `type: module` packages appear as their own rows in that view: not measured — measure first.

## Expected

1. A row the server marks as disableable (the served verdict #28117 adds next to `writable`) shows Enable / Disable, through the existing button and confirm dialog. ⛔ The Console does not re-derive the rule from `manifest.type` / `scope` (#8146: one answer, served by the server).
2. The confirm dialog keeps one sentence of consequence: hidden for every user + no data deleted + can be re-enabled. The current copy already says this; reword only if a module row reads wrong with it, both locales.
3. Every other write action on a module row stays hidden (it is still read-only for authoring).
4. Permission: the existing `manage_metadata` door; no new permission.
5. Tests: a module row with the verdict shows Disable and confirms; a read-only row without it does not; a disabled module row shows Enable.

## Not in scope (ruled)

- A new "suite modules" page, route or nav item (13:07Z 「最小做法」).
- Organization-level scope (13:07Z 「不需要」); plans B / C.
- If the module rows do not appear in the Installed Apps view at all, report it on this card first; ⛔ do not add a new page to work around it.
